key.name: workspace-names
key.description: List of workspace names indexed by workspace number.

key.name: workspace-icons
key.description: List of workspace icons/emojis indexed by workspace number.

key.name: workspace-count
key.description: How many workspaces are configurable in the preferences window.

key.name: display-mode
key.description: What to render inside the workspace switcher OSD. Accepted values: dots, icon, text, both.

key.name: osd-duration-ms
key.description: Duration before the workspace switcher OSD hides.

key.name: container-background-color
key.description: Background color of the OSD container box. Fully transparent by default.

key.name: container-border-radius
key.description: Corner radius, in pixels, of the OSD container box.

key.name: active-text-color
key.description: Color used for the icon and name of the active workspace.

key.name: active-background-color
key.description: Background color behind the active workspace indicator.

key.name: inactive-text-color
key.description: Color used for the icon and name of inactive workspaces.

key.name: inactive-background-color
key.description: Background color behind inactive workspace indicators.

key.name: indicator-border-radius
key.description: Corner radius, in pixels, of each workspace indicator.
